author: nickyeow

english.text: She looks pretty no matter what she wears.

jyutping: keoi5 zoek3 me1 dou1 gam3 leng3。
text: 佢著咩都咁靚。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The color of her dress and that of her shoes go well together.

jyutping: keoi5 tiu4 kwan4 tung4 maai4 deoi3 haai4 di1 sik1 hou2 can3。
text: 佢條裙同埋對鞋啲色好襯。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm so tired that I can't walk any longer.
I'm too tired to walk any longer.

jyutping: ngo5 gui6 dou3 haang4 m4 juk1 laa3。
text: 我攰到行唔郁喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: "Is he coming?" "No, I think not."

jyutping: 「keoi5 lai4 m4 lai4 gaa3？」「m4，ngo5 nam2 keoi5 m4 lai4 laa3。」
text: 「佢嚟唔嚟㗎？」「唔，我諗佢唔嚟喇。」

author: nickyeow

english.text: You have changed so much that I can hardly recognize you.

jyutping: nei5 bin3 zo2 gam3 do1 ge3，ngo5 dou1 caa1 m4 do1 m4 jing6 dak1 nei5 laa3。
text: 你變咗咁多嘅，我都差唔多唔認得你喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Don't forget to return the book to the library.

jyutping: m4 hou2 m4 gei3 dak1 waan4 faan2 bun2 syu1 bei2 tou4 syu1 gun2 wo3。
text: 唔好唔記得還返本書俾圖書館喎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I saw my neighbor's dog running around in the yard.

jyutping: ngo5 gin3 dou2 gaak3 lei4 uk1 joeng5 go2 zek3 gau2 hai2 go3 faa1 jyun2 leoi5 min6 paau2 lai4 paau2 heoi3。
text: 我見到隔籬屋養嗰隻狗喺個花園裏面跑嚟跑去。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Her being fired was a real slap in the face after everything she did for the company.

jyutping: keoi5 wai6 gaan1 gung1 si1 fu6 ceot1 zo2 gam3 do1，dou3 tau4 loi4 ging2 jin4 bei2 jan4 caau2 zo2，deoi3 keoi5 lai4 gong2 zan1 hai6 jat1 go3 hou2 daai6 ge3 mou5 juk6。
text: 佢為間公司付出咗咁多，到頭來竟然俾人炒咗，對佢嚟講真係一個好大嘅侮辱。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I've worked here for ten years.

jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 hai2 ni1 dou6 zou6 zo2 sap6 nin4 laa3。
text: 我已經喺呢度做咗十年喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you have strong likes and dislikes for certain food?

jyutping: nei5 jau5 mou5 di1 me1 je5 sik6 hai6 dak6 bit6 zung1 ji3 waak6 ze2 m4 zung1 ji3 gaa3？
text: 你有冇啲咩嘢食係特別鍾意或者唔鍾意㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: The teacher suggested that we go to the library to study.

jyutping: go3 lou5 si1 tai4 ji5 ngo5 dei6 heoi3 tou4 syu1 gun2 wan1 syu1。
text: 個老師提議我哋去圖書館溫書。

author: nickyeow

english.text: If anybody comes, tell him that I am out.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 jau5 jan4 lai4 wan2 ngo5，zau6 tung4 keoi5 gong2 waa6 ngo5 ceot1 zo2 heoi3。
text: 如果有人嚟搵我，就同佢講話我出咗去。

author: tigro1973

english.text: If I had money, I'd travel all the time.

jyutping: jau5 cin2 ge3 waa2，ngo5 wui5 seng4 jat6 heoi3 leoi5 hang4。
text: 有錢嘅話，我會成日去旅行。

author: tigro1973

english.text: In Japan, it's very hot in the summer.

jyutping: jat6 bun2 haa6 tin1 hou2 jit6。
text: 日本夏天好熱。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Why must you give away all of my secrets?

jyutping: nei5 dim2 gaai2 hai6 dou1 jiu3 gong2 saai3 ngo5 di1 bei3 mat6 bei2 jan4 zi1 gaa3？
text: 你點解係都要講晒我啲秘密俾人知㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Can I cry?

jyutping: ngo5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 haam3 aa3？
text: 我可唔可以喊呀？

author: cc_neko

english.text: A lot of snow fell last year.

jyutping: gau6 nin2 lok6 hou2 do1 syut3。
text: 舊年落好多雪。

author: fercheung

english.text: Tom wanted to get to know Mary better.

jyutping: aa3 Tom soeng2 liu5 gaai2 aa3 Mary do1 di1。
text: 阿Tom想了解阿Mary多啲。

author: fercheung

english.text: What's important isn't which university you've graduated from, but what you learned while you were there.

jyutping: zung6 jiu3 ge3 m4 hai6 nei5 bat1 jip6 jyu1 bin1 gaan1 daai6 hok6，ji4 hai6 nei5 hai2 hok6 haau6 kei4 gaan1 hok6 dou3 di1 mat1 je5。
text: 重要嘅唔係你畢業於邊間大學，而係你喺學校期間學到啲乜嘢。

author: kaenif

english.text: You were jealous.

jyutping: nei5 dou3 gei6。
text: 你妒忌。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Oil does not mix with water.

jyutping: jau4 tung4 seoi2 kau1 m4 maai4。
text: 油同水溝唔埋。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Since you're so smart, why don't you do it yourself?

jyutping: ciu1，nei5 gam3 lek1，zi6 gei2 zou6 aa1。
text: 超，你咁叻，自己做吖。

author: nickyeow

english.text: How many Christmas cards did you write last year?

jyutping: nei5 gau6 nin2 se2 zo2 gei2 do1 zoeng1 sing3 daan3 kaat1？
text: 你舊年寫咗幾多張聖誕卡？

author: nickyeow

english.text: If you don't leave now, you'll be late.

jyutping: nei5 zoi3 m4 zau2 zau6 ci4 dou3 gaa3 laa3。
text: 你再唔走就遲到㗎喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I've had enough.

jyutping: ngo5 baau2 laa3。
text: 我飽喇。

english.text: When are you going back to Malaysia?

jyutping: nei5 gei2 si4 faan2 maa5 loi4 sai1 aa3？
text: 你幾時返馬来西亞？

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Hair loss is often hereditary.

jyutping: lok6 tau4 faat3 tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 wai4 cyun4。
text: 落頭髮通常都係遺傳。

english.text: Tom was late for school as usual.

jyutping: aa3 tong1 faan1 hok6 lai6 ci4。
text: 阿湯返學例遲。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tom passed away last year.

jyutping: aa3 tong1 gau6 nin4 zau2 zo2。
text: 阿湯舊年走咗。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I know that she is Spanish.
I know he's Spanish.

jyutping: ngo5 zi1 keoi5 hai6 sai1 baan1 ngaa4 jan4。
text: 我知渠係西班牙人。

english.text: A quilted work by artist Linda Gass hangs in the entrance of the exhibit. Rebecca Stevens organized the exhibit. She says the work brings together the many subjects in the exhibit. To create the work “Treatment?,” Ms. Gass used cloth and paints to create an image of a water treatment center on the San Francisco Bay. The brightly colored cloth image looks like a photograph of land and river taken from an airplane.

jyutping: ngai6 seot6 gaa1 Linda Gass ge3 si1 cau4 zok3 ban2 gwaa3 hai2 zin2 laam5 jap6 hau2。 Rebecca Stevens zou2 zik1 zo2 ni1 go3 zin2 laam5。keoi5 waa6 ni1 fuk1 zok3 ban2 zoeng1 zin2 laam5 jap6 min6 ge3 hou2 do1 zyu2 tai4 git3 hap6 maai4 jat1 cai4 bing6 cong3 zou6 ceot1 jat1 fuk1 saam1 faan4 si5 waan1 ge3 seoi2 cyu5 lei5 zung1 sam1 ge3 tou4 zoeng6。ni1 fuk1 sin1 jim6 ge3 bou3 tou4 zoeng6 hou2 ci5 hai6 hai2 fei1 gei1 soeng6 min6 jing2 ge3 luk6 dei6 tung4 ho4 lau4 ge3 soeng1。
text: 藝術家 Linda Gass 嘅絲綢作品掛喺展覽入口。 Rebecca Stevens 組織咗呢個展覽。佢話呢幅作品將展覽入面嘅好多主題結合埋一齊並創造出一幅三藩市灣嘅水處理中心嘅圖像。呢幅鮮艷嘅布圖像好似係喺飛機上面影嘅陸地同河流嘅相。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Economics play a large rôle in human affairs. Sometimes, money controls people's behaviour. An interesting speculative fiction movie is THX 1138. It is about the future in which credit flow and balances are carefully checked by a centralized computer. Everybody has a shaven head. Most wear white. The religion seems like a Buddhist-Catholic hybrid. The city is hygienic white and is subterranean. The huge city is like a clean hospital and a shopping mall. George Lucas, the filmmaker of THX 1138, also later made the more famous Star Wars. He has proclaimed his religion as Buddhist Methodist, according to Wikipedia.

jyutping: ging1 zai3 hok6 hai2 jan4 leoi6 si6 mou6 jap6 min6 baan6 jin2 zyu6 zung6 jiu3 ge3 gok3 sik1。jau5 si4，cin2 wui5 hung3 zai3 jan4 dei6 ge3 hang4 wai4。jat1 bou6 jau5 ceoi3 ge3 tau4 gei1 siu2 syut3 din6 jing2 hai6 THX 1138。ni1 go3 hai6 gwaan1 jyu1 mei6 loi4，seon3 taai3 lau4 dung6 tung4 jyu4 ngaak2 wui5 jau4 jat1 bou6 zaap6 zung1 sik1 din6 nou5 zi2 sai3 gim2 caa4。go3 go3 dou1 tai3 gwong1 tau4，daai6 bou6 fan6 dou1 hai6 zoek6 baak6 sik1。ni1 go3 sing4 si5 hai6 wai6 sang1 ge3 baak6 sik1，ji4 ce2 hai6 dei6 haa2 ge3。gan1 geoi3 wai4 gei1 baak3 fo1，keoi5 ji5 ging1 syun1 bou3 keoi5 ge3 zung1 gaau3 hai6 fat6 gaau3 ceon4 dou6 gaau3。
text: 經濟學喺人類事務入面扮演住重要嘅角色。有時，錢會控制人哋嘅行為。一部有趣嘅投機小說電影係 THX 1138。呢個係關於未來，信貸流動同餘額會由一部集中式電腦仔細檢查。個個都剃光頭，大部分都係着白色。呢個城市係衛生嘅白色，而且係地下嘅。根據維基百科，佢已經宣布佢嘅宗教係佛教循道教。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: On the 22nd of March of 2022, I went to the pizzeria twice, in the morning and in the afternoon. I went to the cafe to have Strawberry Coconut Drink in the crowded afternoon. Sitting at different, but proximate tables, were Don, a white man with glasses, and Chen, a stocky Chinese. They were talking. Don was about the same age group as my younger brother Paolo; both went to Rideau Elementary School, whilst I went to Errington Elementary School. I remembered that the Rideau school field was just mounds of dirt with an impromptu mountain bike circulating racetrack. There were red poppies growing. I imagined Star Wars' Jawas lurking in the mounds. It was the late 1970s.

jyutping: hai2 2022 nin4 3 jyut6 22 hou6，ngo5 heoi3 zo2 loeng5 ci3 bok6 beng2 dim3，ziu1 zou2 tung4 haa6 zau3 hai2 jan4 saan1 jan4 hoi2 ge3 haa6 zau3 heoi3 zo2 gaa3 fe1 teng1 jam2 cou2 mui2 je4 zi2 jam2 ban2。 zo6 hai6 m4 tung4 toi2，hai6 jau5 ngaan5 geng2 ge3 baak6 jan4，tung4 maai4 jat1 go3 san1 coi4 cou1 cou3 ge3 can4 wai5 zit3，tung4 sai3 lou2 Paolo daai6 joek3 hai6 tung4 jat1 go3 nin4 ling4 zou2 bit6，ji4 ngo5 gei3 dak1 lei5 do1 hok6 haau6 tin4 zi2 hai6 nai4 tou2 deoi1，jau5 zik1 hing3 saan1 dei6 daan1 ce1 lau4 cyun4。ngo5 soeng2 zoeng6 gwo3 sing1 kau4 daai6 zin3 ge3 gaa2 ngaa5 si1 hai2 di1 tou2 deoi1 jap6 min6 cim4 fuk6 gan2。go2 si4 hai6 1970 nin4 doi6 hau6 kei4。
text: 喺2022年3月22號，我去咗兩次薄餅店，朝早同下晝喺人山人海嘅下晝去咗咖啡廳飲草莓椰子飲品。 坐係唔同枱，係有眼鏡嘅白人，同埋一個身材粗糙嘅陳偉哲，同細佬 Paolo 大約係同一個年齡組別，而我記得里多學校田只係泥土堆，有即興山地單車流傳。我想像過星球大戰嘅賈瓦斯喺啲土堆入面潛伏緊。嗰時係1970年代後期。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: He said, "You are blessed by the Lord, my daughter. You have shown more kindness in the latter end than at the beginning, because you didn’t follow young men, whether poor or rich. Now, my daughter, don’t be afraid. I will do to you all that you say; for all the city of my people knows that you are a worthy woman. Now it is true that I am a near kinsman. However, there is a kinsman nearer than I. Stay this night, and in the morning, if he will perform for you the part of a kinsman, good. Let him do the kinsman's duty. But if he will not do the duty of a kinsman for you, then I will do the duty of a kinsman for you, as the Lord lives. Lie down until the morning."

jyutping: keoi5 waa6：「ngo5 ge3 neoi2 neoi2，nei5 hai6 sau6 zyu2 zuk1 fuk1 ge3。nei5 hai2 zeoi3 hau6 bei2 jat1 hoi1 ci2 biu2 jin6 ceot1 gang3 do1 ge3 sin6 loeng4，jan1 wai6 nei5 mou5 gan1 ceoi4 nin4 hing1 jan4，mou4 leon6 hai6 kung4 ding6 jau5 cin2。ji4 gaa1，ngo5 go3 neoi2 neoi2，m4 sai2 geng1。ngo5 wui5 deoi3 nei5 zou6 so2 jau5 nei5 so2 gong2 ge3；jan1 wai6 ngo5 cyun4 sing4 dou1 zi1 dou6 nei5 hai6 jat1 go3 zik6 dak1 ge3 neoi5 jan4。ji4 gaa1 hai6 zan1，ngo5 hai6 gan6 can1。daan6 hai6，jyu4 gwo2 ni1 go3 je6 maan5 jau5 bei2 ngo5 gang3 gan6 ge3 naam4 jan4 ngo5 wui5 wai6 nei5 lei5 hang4 can1 cik1 ge3 zik1 zaak3，hou2，joeng6 keoi5 zou6 can1 cik1 ge3 zik1 zaak3，daan6 jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 m4 wui5 wai6 nei5 zou6 can1 cik1 ge3 zik1 zaak3，gam2 ngo5 zau6 wui5 wai6 nei5 zou6 can1 cik1 ge3 zik1 zaak3，jan1 wai6 zyu2 zung6 zoi6 saang1。」
text: 佢話：「我嘅囡囡，你係受主祝福嘅。你喺最後比一開始表現出更多嘅善良，因為你冇跟隨年輕人，無論係窮定有錢。而家，我個囡囡，唔使驚。我會對你做所有你所講嘅；因為我全城都知道你係一個值得嘅女人。而家係真，我係近親。但係，如果呢個夜晚有比我更近嘅男人我會為你履行親戚嘅職責，好，讓佢做親戚嘅職責，但如果佢唔會為你做親戚嘅職責，噉我就會為你做親戚嘅職責，因為主仲在生。」
